facts: A new phrase-based translation model is proposed.
A new phrase-based translation model and decoding algorithm enables evaluation of several previously proposed phrase-based translation models.
A new phrase-based translation model and decoding algorithm enables comparison of several previously proposed phrase-based translation models.
A framework is used to carry out a large number of experiments.
The experiments are carried out to understand better and explain why phrase-based models outperform word-based models.
The empirical results hold for all examined language pairs.
The empirical results suggest that the highest levels of performance can be obtained through relatively simple means.
Heuristic learning of phrase translations from word-based alignments is a means to obtain the highest levels of performance.
Lexical weighting of phrase translations is a means to obtain the highest levels of performance.
Learning phrases longer than three words does not have a strong impact on performance.
Learning phrases from high-accuracy word-level alignment models does not have a strong impact on performance.
Learning only syntactically motivated phrases degrades system performance.
The highest levels of performance can be obtained through heuristic learning of phrase translations from word-based alignments and lexical weighting of phrase translations.
